name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Gwen Moore running for reelection
Polymarket prices Moore near certain to win
Republican challenger has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Milwaukee-based WI-04 leans Democratic by 26 points and Moore, a long-serving incumbent, is running again with over $1 million raised and no outside opposition spending. Markets price her at roughly 96% to win, so the forecast stays at a Safe D margin near the fundamentals-based estimate.
model.watch: Any late outside spending against Moore or an unexpectedly strong Republican fundraising surge would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Gwen Moore has held this Milwaukee-area House seat since 2005, and the district's partisan lean of roughly 26 points Democratic makes a general-election upset very unlikely. She is running again after winning renomination, with about $1.1 million raised this cycle, though her cash on hand is modest at under $30,000.

Republican Tim Rogers has reported no fundraising, and no outside groups have spent in the race. Prediction markets put Moore's chances around 96 percent. With no public polling and no expert ratings, the forecast rests on the district's strong Democratic lean, Moore's incumbency, and her financial advantage.
